step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Vacation in Canada — family caregiver benefits — D61 w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
If it is a continuing claim, go to step 9.
If it is an initial or renewal claim, go to step 14.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is an outstanding registration number for the vacation in Canada issue:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 10.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Click Update .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) to advise IPOC to impose the disentitlement as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 2 -Yes.
Complete: Select D - No.
Click Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work Type: Select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Select the appropriate option:
Remarks line 2: Type “The client is not entitled to collect benefits for the vacation in Canada period.”
Remarks line 3: Type your name and telephone number.
Decision Type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Click Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Click Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the N-00-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Special benefits denied (3065):
Select Family caregiver benefits for children denied - D61/D62/D63/Free text (11282) or Family caregiver benefits for adults denied - D61/D62/D63/Free text (11281) .
Select D61 - Not entitled to family caregiver benefits for children - Various reasons (11283) or D61 - Not entitled to family caregiver benefits for adults - Various reasons (11276) .
Select D61 - Child does not meet the definition of critically ill or injured child or D61 - Adult does not meet the definition of critically ill or injured adult .
Select Indefinite/Definite/Multiple Disentitlement dates (2485) .
Select the appropriate dates from the drop down calendar.
Overpayment messages (2452) .
Right to Request a Reconsideration (no Blank Option) (4169): Select Right to Request a Reconsideration .
Go to step 16.

step.cmd: In ACS, create and save the N-00-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Special benefits denied (3065): Select Family caregiver benefits for children denied - D61/D62/D63/Free text (11282) or Family caregiver benefits for adults denied - D61/D62/D63/Free text (11281) .
Select D61 - Not entitled to family caregiver benefits for children - Various reasons (11283) or D61 - Not entitled to family caregiver benefits for adults - Various reasons (11276) .
Select D61 - Child does not meet the definition of critically ill or injured child or D61 - Adult does not meet the definition of critically ill or injured adult .
Select Indefinite/Definite/Multiple Disentitlement dates (2485) .
Select the appropriate dates from the drop-down calendar.
Overpayment messages (2452)
Right to Request a Reconsideration (no Blank Option) (4169): Select Right to Request a Reconsideration .

step.cmd: In NWS, create a client Note and type “Submit MM06 to enter the M161 inputs. D61 from [XXXX-X] to w/c [XXXX-X]. Send the saved N-00-00-00 letter.”
In NWS, complete the WI for the vacation in Canada issue.
